verdict.rationale: PostHog ships feature flags, so the OpenFeature provider question applies, but nothing in the evidence mentions OpenFeature or a vendor-neutral flag provider. The flag docs only cover PostHog's own SDKs, API, MCP and CLI tooling. Mixpanel library compatibility concerns analytics ingestion, not vendor-neutral flag evaluation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
